notes.title: New languages support
notes.content:
Bonjour, ciao, hallo, hola!

We're not just flexing our foreign languages skills — [b]Eador. Genesis[/b] now supports four more additional localizations: French, Italian, German and Spanish!

Many thanks to all the fans who volunteered to translate the game. It's a truly monumental task, given the amount of text in it, and we're very grateful for this.

Cheers and have fun!

notes.title: Eador. Imperium — Early Access Start
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Yes, it's been much too long, but we're still very happy to announce that today we're launching [b]Eador. Imperium,[/b] a new stand-alone expansion for Eador, into [b]Steam Early Access[/b].

Starting with 4 new heroes, 15 new units, new winter Shard world and new tactical map, we're just at the beginning of making something special. We really hope you'll like what we can offer right now!

[url=http://snowbirdgames.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/1.jpg][img]http://snowbirdgames.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/1-1024x576.jpg[/img][/url]

Head over to our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/477730][b]Steam page[/b][/url] for more details.

All Eador. MotBW owners get [b]15% discount[/b] on Eador. Imperium for a limited time.

Join us as we shape the next chapter of Eador!

Watch the trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WCfxFGngfcg

[url=http://snowbirdgames.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/5.jpg][img]http://snowbirdgames.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/5-1024x576.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Gremlins, Inc. & Eador
notes.content:
[img=http://gremlinsinc.com/forum/uploads/monthly_2016_03/announcement_EADOR_pic.jpg.b59d9aa97ec4fb836c64516e03c27885.jpg][/img]

In 2009, Alexey Bokulev designed and developed a turn-based strategy [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/235660/]Eador. Genesis[/url]. That game went on to score [url=http://www.gog.com/game/eador_genesis]really well[/url] with the players. In 2013, we released a 3D remake of the game under the title of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/232050/]Eador: Masters of the Broken World[/url] that successfully sold over 200.000 copies worldwide.

To celebrate the release of Alexey Bokulev's latest game [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/369990]Gremlins, Inc.[/url] that comes out this week and the connection between the world of Eador titles and the world of Gremlins, Inc., on March 11 we issue [u]special Steam coupons[/u] to all the owners of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/235660/]Eador. Genesis[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/232050/]Eador: Masters of the Broken World[/url], entitling them to a one-time discount on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/369990]Gremlins, Inc.[/url] in the period from March 11 – March 31 (if you own one of these games, you will see the coupon in your Steam inventory). 

Dear guests from Eador: welcome to Zarr's world, the world of gremlins!

notes.title: Now Available - Eador: Genesis
notes.content:
Eador: Genesis is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off
Take the role of a mighty Master and shape the destiny of Eador, on land and within the astral plane itself. Explore the land and rule provinces as you see fit, defend them, and keep the populace in line or they may rebel. Choose from thousands of items — swords, spells, weapons, armor, and more — to outfit the heroes you recruit so they may best meet any challenge. Keep your heroes healthy and they will grow stronger as they gain experience from battle. Forge alliances and engage in the delicate art of diplomacy as you negotiate trade agreements or wage war against a mutual foe.

Eador, with its many wonders and adventures, awaits. Will you answer the call?

To celebrate the launch of the original Eador game, the sequel Eador: Masters of the Broken World is today's Daily Deal at 50% off (until October 16th at 10AM).


*Offer ends October 21 at 10AM Pacific Time
